understanding: Bring-up requires fixed-period clock per test with reset assert then deassert coordinated across bus serial and modem interfaces. Documented evidence confirms reset-cleared FIFOs known outputs after reset and WISHBONE clock table points but leaves period strata units polarity duration scaling and idle-check values unresolved so plan retains symbolic coordination only with no DUT timing claims.
preconditions: Clock on wb_clk_i and reset on wb_rst_i connected and owned by common clock and reset controls
Single symbolic PERIOD_TEST selected before reset and held fixed during reset and traffic
No wishbone_bus serial_data or modem_control_if traffic active before power_on_reset coordination completes
stimulus_steps: CONFIGURE the clock to symbolic PERIOD_TEST before any reset or traffic and do not change period during reset or traffic
WAIT for the clock stable for SYM_STABLE_CYCLES clock cycles
ASSERT the reset to symbolic active level SYM_RESET_ACTIVE and HOLD for SYM_RESET_CYCLES scaled to PERIOD_TEST
DEASSERT the reset to symbolic inactive level and WAIT SYM_SETTLE_CYCLES clock cycles for settling

SPAWN per-interface idle handling on wishbone_bus serial_data and modem_control_if via explicit sequencer handles from power_on_reset coordination with spawn only and no delays and no virtual-interface access
FOR each directed documented point and each seeded random stratum sample in separate test REPEAT bring-up with PERIOD_TEST fixed per test
IF period change is required APPLY change only between tests before reset and traffic never during reset or traffic
check_steps: COMPARE DUT outputs for known non-X or non-Z values after wb_rst_i deassertion
COMPARE receiver and transmitter FIFOs for cleared empty state after reset before further traffic
coverage_steps: SAMPLE observed clock edges via clock monitor analysis port to classify PERIOD_TEST into symbolic band and stratum bins
SAMPLE boundary classification for documented points without claiming exhaustive frequency proof or gap coverage
completion: WAIT for reset deassertion plus SYM_IDLE_CYCLES clock cycles then declare bring-up complete
ENFORCE testbench operational timeout TEST_TIMEOUT_CYCLES as limit not as DUT timing requirement
CLEANUP return wishbone_bus serial_data and modem_control_if to idle and release coordination handles
